reason: First complete environment inventory rejected four compiler-generated unsafe specialization axiom declarations of axis/dot. All original authored theorem checks and logical closures passed; conservative gate retained unchanged.

changes.only_change: Add explicit noncomputable modifier to disable unnecessary compiler specialization. Logical body, type, all theorem statements and proof bodies unchanged.
changes.diff:
--- author/Geometry240.lean
+++ final/Geometry240.lean
@@ -16,7 +16,7 @@
 
 def signVal (b : Bool) : ℝ := if b then 1 else -1
 
-def axis (p : Bool × ι) : ι → ℝ := Pi.single p.2 (signVal p.1)
+noncomputable def axis (p : Bool × ι) : ι → ℝ := Pi.single p.2 (signVal p.1)
